title: Telehealth Consultations
desc: Convenient video or phone consultations from the comfort of your home — available for existing patients.
detail: Telehealth appointments are available for existing patients. Medicare rebates apply in line with standard consultation fees. Please note: if you are a new patient or have not attended face-to-face within 12 months, an in-clinic visit is required first.
fullDesc: Telehealth allows you to consult with your GP from the comfort and safety of your home via video or phone. This is especially convenient for follow-up consultations, prescription renewals, test result discussions, and ongoing mental health support. Medicare rebates apply to telehealth consultations based on the appointment day and time — the same as face-to-face visits. Note: Telehealth is available for existing patients who have attended our clinic in the last 12 months.
